scientific_integrity: Analytically proved finite-game payoff phase diagram; exact-rational standalone program supports but does not replace the continuum proof. Identifiable related generalized congestion theory acknowledged; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: A specific two-player three-resource asymmetric bundle game; no minimal resource bound, no convergence claim, no exhaustive related-literature guarantee. The construction uses positive, strictly congestion-monotone resource rewards and times.
title: A sharp pure-equilibrium gap in a two-player reward-rate congestion game
